description: Manages the metadata and structural configuration of various entities within the system, including their fields and display properties. This entity allows for dynamic definition and modification of data structures.

endpoints.name: GetEntities
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all available entity names that can be configured or selected from, typically for dropdowns or selection lists.
example_uses: Show me all the entities I can configure.
What are the names of the entities available in the system?
List all entities for selection.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when you need a simple list of all registered entity names for display or selection purposes, without their full configuration details.

endpoints.name: GetEntityConfiguration
endpoints.description: Retrieves the complete configuration details for a specific entity, identified by its name. This includes its description and all associated field configurations.

entityName.description: The name of the entity whose configuration is to be retrieved.

example_uses: Get the configuration details for the 'Partner' entity.
Retrieve the full setup for the 'Contact' entity.
Show me how the 'Project' entity is configured, including its fields.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to fetch the comprehensive configuration of a single entity, including its fields, for display or modification on a frontend screen.

endpoints.name: SaveEntityConfiguration
endpoints.description: Saves or updates the configuration of an existing entity, including its general description and the detailed setup of its fields. This is used for bulk updates or initial saving of a complete configuration.

entityName.description: The name of the entity for which to save the configuration.

request.description: The request body containing the entity's description and an array of field configurations. Key properties include 'EntityName' and 'Fields'.

example_uses: Update the description and field configurations for the 'Product' entity.
Save the new field definitions for the 'User' entity.
Modify the 'Order' entity's configuration, including its fields and description.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to update the overall configuration of an existing entity, including its general properties and the detailed setup of its fields, in a single operation.

endpoints.name: GetAllEntityConfigurations
endpoints.description: Retrieves all entity configurations present in the system. This endpoint is primarily for administrative purposes, providing a complete overview of all defined entities.
example_uses: List all entity configurations in the system.
Retrieve the full details of every configured entity.
Show me all entity setups for administrative review.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to get a comprehensive list of all configured entities and their details, typically for administrative overview or system-wide reporting.

endpoints.name: CreateEntityConfiguration
endpoints.description: Creates a brand new entity configuration in the system. This defines a new data model or entity type that can then have fields added to it.

request.description: The request body for creating a new entity configuration. Required properties include 'EntityName', 'TableName', 'IsActive', and 'EnableChangeLog'.

example_uses: Create a new entity called 'Invoice' with its associated database table name.
Register a new entity 'Asset' and enable change logging for it.
Define a new entity configuration for 'Task' and set it as active.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to define and register a brand new entity within the system, setting up its basic properties like name, associated table, and activity status.

endpoints.name: UpdateEntityConfiguration
endpoints.description: Updates an existing entity configuration identified by its unique ID. This allows modification of core properties of the entity itself, such as its name, table, or active status.

id.description: The unique identifier of the entity configuration to update.

request.description: The request body for updating an entity configuration. Required properties include 'Id', 'EntityName', 'TableName', 'IsActive', and 'EnableChangeLog'.

example_uses: Update the entity configuration with ID 123, changing its description.
Change the table name for the entity configuration identified by its ID.
Modify the active status of an existing entity configuration with ID 456.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to modify the core properties of an existing entity configuration, such as its name, table, or active status, identified by its unique ID.

endpoints.name: DeleteEntityConfiguration
endpoints.description: Deletes an entity configuration from the system, identified by its unique ID. This action permanently removes the entity's metadata.

id.description: The unique identifier of the entity configuration to delete.

example_uses: Delete the entity configuration with ID 456.
Remove the entity configuration for 'OldData' from the system.
Can you delete entity configuration 789?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to permanently remove an entity configuration from the system using its unique identifier.

endpoints.name: GetEntityFields
endpoints.description: Retrieves all field configurations associated with a specific entity configuration, identified by its entity manager ID.

entityManagerId.description: The unique identifier of the entity manager (entity configuration) to retrieve fields for.

example_uses: Retrieve all fields configured for entity manager ID 1.
Show me the field definitions for the entity with ID 5.
List the fields associated with entity configuration 10.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to retrieve the detailed field configurations for a specific entity, identified by its entity manager ID.

endpoints.name: CreateEntityField
endpoints.description: Creates a new field definition for an existing entity configuration. This allows adding new properties to an entity's data model.

request.description: The request body for creating a new entity field. Required properties include 'EntityManagerId', 'FieldName', 'DataType', 'IsRequired', 'IsActive', 'EnableChangeLog', 'DisplayOrder', and 'ShowInListView'.

example_uses: Add a new 'Email' field to the 'Contact' entity, making it required.
Create a field named 'ProjectStatus' with data type 'string' for entity manager ID 2.
Define a new boolean field 'IsApproved' for an entity with a specific display order.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to add a new field definition to an existing entity configuration, specifying its properties like name, data type, and display options.

endpoints.name: UpdateEntityField
endpoints.description: Updates an existing entity field's configuration, identified by its unique ID. This allows modification of field properties such as data type, required status, or display order.

id.description: The unique identifier of the entity field to update.

request.description: The request body for updating an entity field. Required properties include 'Id', 'EntityManagerId', 'FieldName', 'DataType', 'IsRequired', 'IsActive', 'EnableChangeLog', 'DisplayOrder', and 'ShowInListView'.

example_uses: Update the field with ID 10, changing its data type to 'integer'.
Modify the 'Description' of field 25 for entity manager 3.
Change the display order of an entity field with ID 15.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to modify the properties of an existing entity field, identified by its unique ID, within a specific entity configuration.

endpoints.name: DeleteEntityField
endpoints.description: Deletes a specific field definition from an entity configuration, identified by its unique ID. This action permanently removes the field's metadata.

id.description: The unique identifier of the entity field to delete.

example_uses: Delete the entity field with ID 30.
Remove the 'OldField' from the entity configuration.
Can you delete field 42?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to permanently remove a specific field definition from an entity configuration using its unique identifier.

endpoints.name: GetRelatedEntityFields
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of available fields for a specified related entity type. This is typically used when configuring relationship fields between different entities.

entityType.description: The type or name of the related entity for which to retrieve available fields.

example_uses: What fields are available for the 'Project' entity when configuring a relationship?
List fields for related entity type 'Department'.
Show me the fields I can link to from the 'User' entity.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to retrieve a list of fields from a specified related entity type, typically used when defining or configuring relationship fields between entities.

endpoints.name: GetFieldOptionsForDataType
endpoints.description: Retrieves specific configuration options or constraints applicable to fields of a certain data type within the context of a particular entity.

dataType.description: The data type for which to retrieve field options (e.g., 'string', 'integer', 'boolean').

contextEntityName.description: The name of the entity providing context for the field options.

example_uses: What field options are available for 'string' data type in the context of the 'Product' entity?
Show me options for 'integer' fields within the 'Order' entity.
Retrieve field options for 'boolean' data type in the 'User' entity context.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to retrieve specific configuration options or constraints applicable to fields of a certain data type within the context of a particular entity.

endpoints.name: GetEntityListViewConfiguration
endpoints.description: Retrieves the list view configuration for a specific entity, which includes details for dynamic column generation and display properties in a list view.

entityName.description: The name of the entity whose list view configuration is to be retrieved.

example_uses: Get the list view settings for the 'Contact' entity.
How is the 'Project' entity's list view configured?
Retrieve the display columns for the 'Task' entity's list view.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to retrieve the configuration details necessary to dynamically generate a list view (e.g., table columns, display order) for a specific entity.
